title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlights the power of courage and willpower to overcome challenges
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlights the power of courage  and willpower to overcome challenges Posted On:
                17 MAR 2026 8:41AM by PIB Delhi Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting the significance of self-confidence and inner strength in conquering life's most difficult obstacles. The Prime Minister remarked that for an individual filled with courage and resolve, nothing in life is impossible. Shri Modi affirmed that we can overcome the most difficult challenges on the strength of willpower and self-confidence. The Prime Minister wrote on X; "जो व्यक्ति साहस और संकल्प से भरा हो, उसके लिए जीवन में कुछ भी असंभव नहीं। आत्मविश्वास और इच्छाशक्ति के बल पर हम कठिन से कठिन चुनौतियों को पार कर सकते हैं। एकोऽपि सिंहः साहस्रं यूथं मथ्नाति दन्तिनाम् । तस्मात् सिंहमिवोदारमात्मानं वीक्ष्य सम्पतेत्॥" Just as one lion has the power to defeat a thousand elephants, in the same way a person should engage in noble actions fearlessly, with courage, confidence, and inner strength like a lion. जो व्यक्ति साहस और संकल्प से भरा हो, उसके लिए जीवन में कुछ भी असंभव नहीं। आत्मविश्वास और इच्छाशक्ति के बल पर हम कठिन से कठिन चुनौतियों को पार कर सकते हैं। एकोऽपि सिंहः साहस्रं यूथं मथ्नाति दन्तिनाम् । तस्मात् सिंहमिवोदारमात्मानं वीक्ष्य सम्पतेत्॥ pic.twitter.com/LaGaUXgZ00 — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) March 17, 2026 *** MJPS/PRK (Release ID: 2240999) Visitor Counter : 133 Read this release in: Manipuri , Gujarati Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlights the power of courage  and willpower to overcome challenges Posted On:

title: Workshop on ‘Capacity Building Workshop on Monitoring Frameworks of Sustainable Development Goals, Compilation of Environment Accounts, and Gender Statistics’ during 18-19th March, 2026, Patna (Bihar)
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation Workshop on ‘Capacity Building Workshop on Monitoring Frameworks of Sustainable Development Goals, Compilation of Environment Accounts, and Gender Statistics’ during 18-19th March, 2026, Patna (Bihar) Posted On:
                17 MAR 2026 10:09AM by PIB Delhi The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) constantly endeavours to have good quality robust data. Keeping this in view the MoSPI is organising Two days capacity building workshop on ‘Monitoring Frameworks of Sustainable Development Goals, compilation of Environment Accounts, and Gender statistics during 18-19 March 2026, Patna, Bihar. This capacity building workshop is co-organised by Government of Bihar with the Technical Support by United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) India. The workshop has the prime aim of capacity development in three crucial aspects- SDGs, Environment and Gender which will enable facilitation of evidence-based decision. The workshop will have participation from line Ministries, State/UT Departments and other international agencies to discuss critical issues as well as to share best practices. The workshop is likely to be graced by the Hon’ble Minister of Planning and Development, Government of Bihar, Secretary, MoSPI and Chief Secretary, Government of Bihar along with Senior Officers from MoSPI, officers from Government of Bihar and representatives of UN agencies. The First Day of the workshops will be dedicated to the discussions on SDGs and Gender Statistics. Representatives from stakeholder Ministries/Departments, State Governments, institutions and UN agencies will share their experiences and perspectives. The first technical session on SDGs will focus on key issues such as National Indicator Farmwork (NIF) and State Indicator framework aligning SDG indicators. The session will highlight how SDG data will move beyond simple monitoring to support evidence-based policy making and governance. Valuable perspective and experiences from UN agencies will also be shared during the discussion.  In addition, the second technical session on Gender Statistics will examine the important role of gender statistics in promoting women-led development and strengthening institutional frameworks for gender-responsive governance. Day Two of the workshop will focus on important of environmental aspects. The discussions include SEEA framework for environmental accounting, methods for valuing forests services, biodiversity, and other ecosystem services. States will also share their experiences in compiling and advancing environmental accounts and statistics.  The discussion will also draw the perspective of environmental experts on environmental account and statistics *********** Samrat (Release ID: 2241007) Visitor Counter : 28 Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation Workshop on ‘Capacity Building Workshop on Monitoring Frameworks of Sustainable Development Goals, Compilation of Environment Accounts, and Gender Statistics’ during 18-19th March, 2026, Patna (Bihar) Posted On:
